# Count films per year for Radhika Pandit
films_per_year = df.groupby('Year').size()
# Filter years with at least two films
years_with_at_least_two_films = films_per_year[films_per_year >= 2].index.tolist()
# Sort years in ascending order
years_with_at_least_two_films.sort()
# Return the first year from the sorted list
answer = years_with_at_least_two_films[0] if years_with_at_least_two_films else None
